summary: Round 3 of T3-03 passes. Both story checks ran clean: the 275 resampler tests pass, and make check (ruff, format, mypy) passes. The round-2 fixes are in the code. Masked sources are treated as missing, the sentinel is compared in the source's storage type, and the boundary and zero-rounding cases raise or round as intended. The changes to geometry.py and test_geometry_resample.py are within the story's files. I did not re-read the failing-test-first records or the lookup and plane tests; those rest on the earlier rounds and the commit order.

checks.evidence: ruff check passed, ruff format --check reported 10 files already formatted, and mypy reported no issues in 10 source files.

checks.criterion: Bilinear on four neighbours only; outside is nodata, never zero-filled; no cubic or averaging
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1167-1178 computes inside, then the four-neighbour validity, then the (1-p), p and (1-q), q blend. Outside points become NaN with valid=False.

checks.criterion: Explicit boolean valid mask beside the float64 array; missing is never 0; NaN, sentinel and masked-array inputs behave identically
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1138-1158 merges the NaN, sentinel and np.ma.getmaskarray masks into one good mask. Lines 1179-1183 return values, valid and inside, with invalid pixels set to NaN. The sentinel is compared in the source type (lines 1224-1264). The 275 tests pass.

checks.criterion: Three lookup forms, parameters explicit, plane test, and tests written failing first
checks.evidence: The diff scope contains the three lookups, and the full test module passes. The commit order shows test commits before their fix commits (63bc9ea before 2b0a044). I did not independently re-inspect the plane-test tolerances or the missing-parameter raise tests.
